title: SPARC Cat Acute UroMOCA Implantation
author: Anna Rietsch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bf2kjqcw
materials: Transport cat from housing site to surgery site.
Cleveland Clinic animal team euthanizes the animal

steps.title: Prepare Animal for Surgery
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the cat, shave the abdomen, and move the animal to the surgery room to be attached to monitors.

steps.title: Sterilize Surgical Site
steps.instruction: Drape the animal and perform a betadine scrub on the abdomen and genitals.

steps.title: Insert Bladder Catheter
steps.instruction: Insert a 3.5Fr catheter into the bladder through the urethra using surgilube.

substeps.instruction: Advance the catheter until resistance is met
Pull back 2-3cm

steps.title: Collect Urine Sample
steps.instruction: Withdraw urine from the bladder through the catheter using gentle suction with a syringe.

substeps.instruction: Measure the volume (e.g., 7 mL removed)
Record conductivity (e.g., 40.78 mS/cm, 41.54 mS/cm, 41.52 mS/cm)
Save urine for urinalysis

steps.title: Visualize Bladder via CT
steps.instruction: Use a 1:10 dilution of contrast to saline to visualize the bladder.

substeps.instruction: Fill the bladder with contrast and take a 3D CT image
Add 10 mL more contrast to the bladder and take another 3D CT image

steps.title: Perform Initial Pressure Recording
steps.instruction: Transfer the cat from isoflurane to propofol anesthetic and record bladder pressure using Labview software and an external pressure transducer connected to a syringe pump.

substeps.instruction: Fill bladder with saline at a rate of 2ml/minute using a syringe pump
Fill to 15 mL

steps.title: Empty Bladder
steps.instruction: Remove 17 ml of saline and urine from the bladder.

steps.title: Implant UroMOCA Device
steps.instruction: Access and open the bladder (refer to 'SPARC Cat surgery Day 0' protocol).

substeps.instruction: Make a 1 cm incision in the bladder
Place the device in the bladder, leaving power wires outside the bladder
Suture the bladder closed and check for leaks
Place the bladder back into the body

steps.title: Close Abdomen
steps.instruction: Close the abdomen, ensuring the power wires remain outside of the animal.

steps.title: Verify Device Function and Pressure
steps.instruction: Fill the bladder with saline at 2ml/min and record pressure via LabView to verify UroMOCA response.

substeps.instruction: Fill to 12 mL (observe for spontaneous contractions)
Fill to 15 mL (verify pressure response from UroMOCA is seen)

steps.title: Record Non-Voiding Contractions
steps.instruction: Fill the bladder with saline and record pressure via LabView to identify non-voiding contractions.

substeps.instruction: Fill to 12 mL
Fill to 13 mL
Fill to 16 mL

steps.title: Test Wireless Transmission
steps.instruction: Confirm that data is being sent wirelessly from the UroMOCA to the receiving radio.

steps.title: Perform Post-Implantation CT
steps.instruction: Infuse contrast (1:10 dilution) and take CT images.

substeps.instruction: Infuse 10mL of contrast and take a single CT image
Infuse an additional 5mL of contrast and take a single CT image

steps.title: Test Mechanical Stimulation
steps.instruction: Fill bladder with saline at 2ml/min and record pressure via LabView.

substeps.instruction: Fill to 15 mL
Tug on catheter to observe for large contraction

steps.title: Perform Saline Bolus Infusions
steps.instruction: Infuse various saline concentrations in boluses of 3mL, 6mL, 9mL, 12mL, and 15mL at a rate of 10mL/minute while UroMOCA transmits data.

substeps.instruction: Infuse 0.9% saline
Infuse 1.5% saline (repeat multiple times as per original record)
Infuse 3.0% saline (repeat multiple times as per original record)
Infuse 0.9% saline
Infuse 3.0% saline
Rotate animal on right side and infuse 0.9% saline

steps.title: Harvest Bladder
steps.instruction: Remove the bladder and place it in formalin for histological analysis.
